requirements.evidence: All contract items are implemented: CreateQueue.php:23-57 trims the name, slugifies the slug, validates 1-255, checks per-entity uniqueness and creates an active queue; UpdateQueue.php:22-80 takes nullable name/slug/isActive and excludes the queue itself from the slug check; SetQueueAccess.php:27-70 authorizes, rejects cross-entity pairs, upserts/revokes and logs granted/revoked only when a row was deleted; migration 2026_10_29_035453_create_queue_access_table.php:14-29 has both cascading FKs, JSON permissions, timestamps, the unique pair and a reversible down(); QueueAccess.php:11-41 provides table, fillable, array cast and both relations; QueuePolicy.php:17-70 implements create/update/manageAccess/call including the corrupted non-array denial; CallNextTicket.php:32 and Ticket.php:99-107 enforce lock, inactive check, authorization, then the waiting rule.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes live in app/Actions with Gate authorization inside each action (CreateQueue.php:25, UpdateQueue.php:29, SetQueueAccess.php:33), authorization is a policy (QueuePolicy.php:12-70), the migration follows the generated reversible style (2026_10_29_035453_create_queue_access_table.php:14-29), mass assignment is bounded with the same #[Fillable] attribute used by siblings (QueueAccess.php:11), and the requested docs/CHANGELOG are updated (CHANGELOG.md:21-23, docs/business-rules.md:70-89, docs/database-schema.md:143). Deviation: the slug/unique helpers are duplicated between the two actions (CreateQueue.php:60-84 vs UpdateQueue.php:82-107).

security.evidence: Every action authorizes before writing (CreateQueue.php:25, UpdateQueue.php:29, SetQueueAccess.php:33) and both call paths authorize the caller (CallNextTicket.php:32, Ticket.php:103); permissions are whitelisted through QueuePermission (SetQueueAccess.php:76-91), a corrupted non-array grant denies (QueuePolicy.php:56-62), and QueueAccess limits mass assignment (QueueAccess.php:11). No user-controlled output/escaping surface exists in this slice.

tests.evidence: New Pest suites cover the happy paths, all unauthorized cases, invalid/non-string permissions, corrupted permissions, cascade deletes and both call paths: QueueManagementTest.php:1-192, QueueAccessTest.php:1-205, QueuePolicyTest.php:1-134, CallNextTicketTest.php:257-300, IssueTicketTest.php:148-201. Missing: the QueryException unique-race branch (CreateQueue.php:47-57, UpdateQueue.php:65-77) and UpdateQueue's invalid name/slug validation (UpdateQueue.php:33-51) have no tests.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the existing Queue/EntityMembership/User models and Gate with no extra layer; however ensureSlugIsAvailable() and isUniqueViolation() are near-verbatim duplicates (CreateQueue.php:60-84 vs UpdateQueue.php:82-107), and the factory creates related rows in afterMaking (QueueAccessFactory.php:36-58).

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with docblocks (CreateQueue.php:17-23, QueuePolicy.php:14-43, SetQueueAccess.php:17-26), consistent names with sibling actions/models, and no dead code or debug output; the non-obvious factory hook is explained (QueueAccessFactory.php:28-36).

scope.evidence: Only queue lifecycle/access/policy code, their tests and the three requested docs are touched; no delete action, no UI/HTTP/Livewire and no extra permissions, matching the task's out-of-scope list.

issues.explanation: The QueryException fallback that turns a DB unique-index race into a ValidationException (explicitly required by task requirement 2) has no test, so it can regress unnoticed.
UpdateQueue's validation of an empty or over-255-character name and slug is untested, while only the create-side equivalents are covered.
ensureSlugIsAvailable() and isUniqueViolation() are duplicated almost verbatim in both actions and should be shared.
The factory creates the membership and queue inside afterMaking, so even make() writes to the database; a dedicated state or helper would be less surprising.
isUniqueViolation() treats every SQLSTATE 23000 (including foreign-key violations) as a duplicate slug, which could mislabel an unexpected integrity error.

review.summary: The change implements queue creation/update/deactivation, per-queue access grants with audit logging, a QueuePolicy and call authorization in both ticket call paths, plus tests and the requested docs updates. Requirements, security and scope are met, so the PR is approvable after adding tests for the unique-index race and update-validation branches and de-duplicating the slug helpers; confidence is medium because the diff does not show the pre-existing User::membershipFor/UserRole helpers or the audit channel it relies on.
